question: Does the provisional-text metrics task start at design?

artifacts.summary: Adds the recognition-side companion to #477: record the per-update text series and report prefix-matched accuracy at first-visible, time-weighted error rate, visible changes split into appends and rewrites, clip-complete time, and a same-arm replicate. Commit-policy changes move these numbers while leaving the final score alone, so a report without them cannot tell two products apart.
